description: Schools and other education units in Indonesia, one gzipped JSON file per province (public data, no personal data), linked to the Kemendagri region codes of the wilayah set, with the latitude/longitude of each unit's detail page.
source: https://referensi.data.kemendikdasmen.go.id/satpen/<group>/<district>/3 (Kemendikdasmen Dapodik reference pages; Dikdas, Dikmen, PAUD and Dikmas lists per district, status 'all', crawled 2026-11-26) and https://referensi.data.kemendikdasmen.go.id/satpen/detail/<npsn> (Lintang, Bujur and Jenjang Pendidikan of every unit, crawled on the version date); the pages show no source date
licence: Public government data, no personal data
procedure: tools/converters/sekolah.py fetch (raw list pages) then build; regions matched by name to wilayah 2026-02-13, never invented (F-028 for what is kept). Coordinates (R-17): coords (detail pages, raw pages kept outside the repository, extracts in sources/sekolah/koordinat/<regency>.tsv) then coords-merge, checked against the regency boundaries in sources/sekolah/batas-wilayah (F-035)

fields.npsn: NPSN as published: 8 characters (non-formal units may start with a letter); 'NP…' numbers are temporary numbers, not NPSNs
fields.bentuk_pendidikan: form as published: SD, MI, SMP, MTs, SMA, MA, SMK, SLB, SPK …, PDF …, TK, KB, RA, …
fields.alamat: street address as published (empty for a few units)
fields.kode_desa: Kemendagri village code xx.xx.xx.xxxx (wilayah), null when the name does not match uniquely
fields.kode_kecamatan: Kemendagri district code xx.xx.xx, null when unmatched
fields.kode_kabupaten: Kemendagri regency code xx.xx, null when unmatched
fields.kode_kecamatan_dapodik: 6-digit Dapodik district code of the source page
fields.lintang: latitude in decimal degrees from the unit's detail page (Lintang), rounded to 7 decimals; null when koordinat_cek is nol, kosong, bawaan, luar_indonesia, halaman_lain or belum_diambil
fields.bujur: longitude in decimal degrees (Bujur), same rules as lintang
fields.koordinat_cek: check of the pair (F-035): kabupaten (inside the unit's regency or within 5 km of it; at sea or on an island the simplified boundaries leave out, when its regency is the nearest within 50 km) | provinsi (in another regency of its province; kept as printed) | luar_provinsi (elsewhere in Indonesia; kept as printed) | tidak_diperiksa (no region code to check against) | nol (0 printed) | kosong (nothing printed) | bawaan (a default pair used by 10 or more units in 3 or more regencies; listed in coordinates.default_pairs) | luar_indonesia (outside Indonesia and no correction fits) | halaman_lain (the page shows another NPSN) | belum_diambil (page not fetched)
fields.koordinat_perbaikan: null when the pair is used as printed; otherwise the correction that puts it in the unit's own regency (F-035): tanda_lintang (latitude sign), tanda_bujur, tertukar (Lintang and Bujur swapped), tertukar_tanda (swapped, latitude sign); printed values in the manifest errata
fields.koordinat_sama: number of units in the whole set with exactly the same pair (1 = unique); null without a pair

notes: Only active units: the district lists leave out units the source marks as merged or closed (their detail pages say e.g. 'STATUS SATUAN PENDIDIKAN: MERGER').
Madrasah (MI, MTs, MA) come from the same Kemendikdasmen lists; their NSM follows from Kemenag (R-02).

Kept forms and regions: decision F-028. Region codes are matched by name to wilayah; spelling variants are accepted only when one candidate remains and numbers and words such as Utara/Barat/Lama agree (count in matched_by_spelling_variant, full list printed by the build); otherwise the code is null.
Village codes point to the village of the school's Dapodik district; where Dapodik and Kemendagri place a village in different districts the code stays null.

Coordinates come from each unit's detail page as the source prints them; nothing is estimated (F-035). Pairs outside the unit's regency stay as printed and are flagged (provinsi, luar_provinsi); a lost sign or swapped Lintang/Bujur is corrected only when the result lies in the unit's own regency (coordinate_errata); default pairs shared across regencies are null (bawaan, coordinates.default_pairs).

Coordinates cross-checked against arumiforge/sinaubareng docs/data/schools (Pati, Kudus, Jepara SD/MI, crawled 2026-11-03): of 2,148 units with a pair in both, 2,136 are identical; the other 12 were changed at the source since (10 moved by 0.02 to 7.3 km, 2 now print 0).
Coordinates: the detail pages of two SD in Sumba Barat and Sumba Barat Daya give Jenjang Pendidikan 'DIKTI'; they are counted under that label in coordinates.by_group as printed.
